Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Inductives.UniformParams

The Uniform Parameters of an Eliminator Varying

The contexts of an eliminator's motives and branches are instances at its uniform parameters; at equal uniform parameters, they are equal telescopes. So the blocks typed at the uniform parameters (blocks_typed) are typed at equal ones, and the motive's instance at the non-uniform parameters and the scrutinee is equal at equal ones.
Two uses need this: the presupposition of the eliminator's congruence, whose right-hand side carries the uniform parameters of the right parameters (wf_elim_cong_rhs, below), and a checker, which infers the parameters of the scrutinee's type, equal to, not the same as, those of a derivation. Nothing here uses the presupposition of term equality: the lemmas come before it.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia List PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require String.

From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Inductives Require Import Typing Views.
Import Syntax_Notations Wk_Notations GlobalCtx_Notations.
#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {Θ : gdeps} {Ξ : gstack}.

Telescopes of Assumptions


  Lemma sb_qn_eq_ext : forall Ψ Δ Γ σ σ', all_assumptions Ψ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Ψ σ ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length Ψ) σ ≈ sb_qn (List.length Ψ) σ' : Ψ ++ Δ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hass HΨ Hσ.
    exact (proj1 (proj1 (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 sub_eq_preserves_mut)))) _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_ext_refl _ _ _ _ Hass HΨ) _ _ _ Hσ) Hass)).
  Qed.

  Lemma tele_sub_eq_ext : forall Ψ Δ Γ σ σ', all_assumptions Ψ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ tele_sub Ψ σ ≈ tele_sub Ψ σ'.
  Proof.
    induction Ψ as [| e Ψ IH]; intros * Hass HΨ Hσ.
    - cbn; constructor; exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)).
    - apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Hass as [(κ & A & ->) Hass'].
      cbn [List.app] in HΨ; destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind HΨ) as [HΨ' (j & HSk & HA)].
      pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HSk) as HS.
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_refl _ _ _ _ _ (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)) as Hσσ.
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_refl _ _ _ _ _ (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)) as Hσσ'.
      pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass' HΨ' Hσ) as Hq.
      pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass' HΨ' Hσσ) as Hq1.
      pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass' HΨ' Hσσ') as Hq2.
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq1) as Hs1.
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq2) as Hs2.
      cbn [tele_sub centry_sub].
      eapply wf_ext_eq_ass_eq; [ exact (IH _ _ _ _ Hass' HΨ' Hσ) | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS Hs1) | exact HSk
                               | exact (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS Hq)
                               | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq))
                               | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS Hs2) ].
  Qed.

The heads of two telescopes of assumptions moved by equal substitutions: equal at one sort, which a telescope equation (wf_ext_eq_ass) no longer records.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record telescope_heads_eq (Γ Ψ Ψ' : ctx) (κ : abs_kind) (A A' : typ) : Prop := mk_telescope_heads_eq
    {
The sort both heads are of
      heads_eq_sort : exp
      
It is a sort of the heads' kind
    ; heads_eq_sort_ok : sort_kind heads_eq_sort κ
      
The telescopes before the heads are equal
    ; heads_eq_tail : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ'
      
The left head is of the sort, in the left telescope
    ; heads_eq_left : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A : heads_eq_sort
      
The heads are equal at it, in the left telescope
    ; heads_eq_equation : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : heads_eq_sort
      
The right head is of the sort, in the right telescope
    ; heads_eq_right : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ A' : heads_eq_sort }.

A telescope of assumptions with a head, moved by equal substitutions: the heads are equal at the head's sort.
  Lemma tele_sub_eq_ext_head : forall Ψ κ A Δ Γ σ σ', all_assumptions Ψ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (Ψ ▹{κ} A) ++ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
      telescope_heads_eq Γ (tele_sub Ψ σ) (tele_sub Ψ σ') κ A[sb_qn (List.length Ψ) σ] A[sb_qn (List.length Ψ) σ'].
  Proof.
    intros * Hass HΨ Hσ.
    cbn [List.app] in HΨ; destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind HΨ) as [HΨ' (j & HSk & HA)].
    pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HSk) as HS.
    pose proof (wf_sub_eq_refl _ _ _ _ _ (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)) as Hσσ'.
    pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass HΨ' Hσ) as Hq.
    pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass HΨ' Hσσ') as Hq2.
    exact (mk_telescope_heads_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ j HSk (tele_sub_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass HΨ' Hσ)
             (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq))
             (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS Hq)
             (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq2))).
  Qed.

Equal telescopes of assumptions, chained.
  Lemma ext_eq_trans_ass : forall Γ Ψ1 Ψ2 Ψ3, all_assumptions Ψ1 -> all_assumptions Ψ2 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ1 ≈ Ψ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ2 ≈ Ψ3 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ1 ≈ Ψ3.
  Proof.
    induction Ψ1 as [| e1 Ψ1 IH]; intros * Ha1 Ha2 H12 H23.
    - destruct Ψ2; [| apply ext_eq_length in H12; discriminate ]; exact H23.
    - destruct Ψ2 as [| e2 Ψ2]; [ apply ext_eq_length in H12; discriminate |].
      destruct Ψ3 as [| e3 Ψ3]; [ apply ext_eq_length in H23; discriminate |].
      apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Ha1 as [(κ1 & A1 & ->) Ha1'].
      apply List.Forall_cons_iff in Ha2 as [(κ2 & A2 & ->) Ha2'].
      assert (κ2 = κ1) as -> by (inversion H12; subst; reflexivity).
      destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H12) as [S1 HS1 S2 HS2 H12' HA1 HA2 HA12 HA21].
      assert (exists A3, e3 = ce_ass κ1 A3) as [A3 ->] by (inversion H23; subst; eauto).
      destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H23) as [S2' HS2' S3 HS3 H23' HA2b HA3 HA23 HA32].
The second step's refinements, read in the first telescope.
      pose proof (ctxsub_ext_rev _ _ _ _ _ H12' Ha1') as HId.
      pose proof (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HA23) as HA23'.
      pose proof (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HA32) as HA32'.
      eapply wf_ext_eq_ass;
        [ exact (IH _ _ Ha1' Ha2' H12' H23') | exact HA1 | exact HS1 | exact HA3 | exact HS3
        | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact HA12 | exact HA23' ]
        | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact HA32' | exact HA21 ] ].
  Qed.

The Motives' Contexts


  Lemma uvars_typed : forall Γ p D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      forall k U T, List.nth_error (vars_from 0 (ind_nu D)) k = Some U ->
        List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (vars_from 0 (ind_nu D))) k = Some T ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ++ Γ ⊢ U : T.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl HΓ k U T HU HT.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    change 0 with (List.length (@nil centry)) in HU, HT.
    pose proof (wf_uparams_app _ _ _ HD Hc _ HΓ) as HUΓ.
    rewrite <- (tele_sub_id (ind_uparams D)) in HUΓ |- *.
    eapply (wf_vars_tele_gen _ _ nil (ind_uparams D) Id Id Γ 0); try eassumption.
    - exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc).
    - exact (decl_mvc_uparams _ (decl_typed_mvc _ _ _ HD)).
    - exact (decl_closed_uparams _ Hc).
    - intros; lia.
  Qed.

  Lemma elim_mctx_canon : forall p D k M V, decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> List.length V = ind_nu D ->
      elim_mctx p D k M V = tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k M (vars_from 0 (ind_nu D))) (sb_of_list Id V).
  Proof.
    intros * Hc Hk HV.
    rewrite elim_mctx_sub by (exact Hc || exact Hk || apply length_vars_from).
    rewrite <- HV, vars_from_sb_of_list; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Lemma elim_mctx_canon_wf : forall Γ p D k M, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D k M (vars_from 0 (ind_nu D)) ++ ind_uparams D ++ Γ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    eapply elim_mctx_wf; [ exact Hg | exact HDs | exact Hl | exact Hk | exact (wf_uparams_app _ _ _ HD Hc _ HΓ) | apply length_vars_from |].
    exact (uvars_typed _ _ _ Hl HΓ).
  Qed.

  Lemma elim_mctx_us_eq : forall Γ p D k M Us Us', ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D k M Us ≈ elim_mctx p D k M Us'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    rewrite (elim_mctx_canon p D k M Us Hc Hk HUl), (elim_mctx_canon p D k M Us' Hc Hk HUl').
    eapply tele_sub_eq_ext; [ eapply elim_mctx_ass; eassumption | exact (elim_mctx_canon_wf _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ) | exact Hσ ].
  Qed.

The heads of the motives' contexts at equal uniform parameters: the member's types, equal at one sort.
  Lemma elim_mctx_head_us_eq : forall Γ p D k M Us Us', ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some M -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      telescope_heads_eq Γ (tele_sub (im_nparams M) (sb_of_list Id Us)) (tele_sub (im_nparams M) (sb_of_list Id Us')) ak_relevant
        (ind_mty p D k (List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn (im_nn M)]ʷ) Us) (vars_from 0 (im_nn M)))
        (ind_mty p D k (List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn (im_nn M)]ʷ) Us') (vars_from 0 (im_nn M))).
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    pose proof (elim_mctx_canon p D k M Us Hc Hk HUl) as E.
    pose proof (elim_mctx_canon p D k M Us' Hc Hk HUl') as E'.
    pose proof (elim_mctx_canon_wf _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ) as HW.
    unfold elim_mctx at 1 in E; unfold elim_mctx at 1 in E'.
    unfold elim_mctx in HW, E, E'; cbn [tele_sub centry_sub] in E, E'.
    injection E as Eh Et; injection E' as Eh' Et'.
    rewrite Eh, Et, Eh', Et'.
    eapply tele_sub_eq_ext_head; [ apply all_assumptions_sub; eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption | exact HW | exact Hσ ].
  Qed.

The Recursive Results' Instances


  Lemma wf_sub_eq_prefix : forall Ψ Δ Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ++ Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ.
  Proof.
    intros * [Hl0 Hr0 Ha Hm] HΔ; constructor;
      [ exact (wf_sub_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl0 HΔ) | exact (wf_sub_prefix _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr0 HΔ) | |].
    - intros x A Hx; apply Ha, ctx_lookup_app_l; exact Hx.
    - intros x U Hx; eapply Hm, ctx_lookup_mod_app_l; exact Hx.
  Qed.

The motive's instance at a shape's leaf, at equal substitutions of the shape's components.
  Lemma ih_leaf_sub_eq : forall Γ p D j Mj Us Ψ Tc β σ σ' Ps x,
      decl_typed Θ Ξ D -> decl_closed D -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ β : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ : Tc -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Tc ->
      shape_uc D Us Tc σ β ->
      List.length Ps = im_nn Mj ->
      (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (List.length Tc - ind_nu D))) Ps) k = Some T ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Tc ⊢ P : T) ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ x : ind_mty p D j (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) (List.map (fun P => P[σ]) Ps) ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list β (List.map (fun P => P[σ]) Ps ++ x :: nil)
        ≈ sb_of_list β (List.map (fun P => P[σ']) Ps ++ x :: nil) : elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ.
  Proof.
    intros * HD Hc Hj HUl HM Hβ Hσ Hσσ Huc HPl HP Hx.
    assert (HN : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ)
      by (unfold elim_mctx in HM; cbn [List.app] in HM; destruct (ctx_decomp HM) as [H0 _]; exact H0).
    assert (Hnn : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list β (List.map (fun P => P[σ]) Ps) ≈ sb_of_list β (List.map (fun P => P[σ']) Ps)
                    : tele_sub (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ).
    { (* each instance is the parameter's own type moved by σ *)
      set (σ0 := sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (List.length Tc - ind_nu D))).
      assert (Hinst : forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P ->
                 List.nth_error (tele_insts (tele_sub (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id Us)) β (List.map (fun P => P[σ]) Ps)) k = Some T ->
                 exists T0, List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) σ0 Ps) k = Some T0 /\ T = T0[σ]).
      { intros k P T HPk HT; rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub in HT.
        assert (HT0 : exists T0, List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) σ0 Ps) k = Some T0).
        { destruct (List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) σ0 Ps) k) as [T0 |] eqn:E0; [ eauto |].
          apply List.nth_error_None in E0; rewrite length_tele_insts in E0 by (eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption).
          rewrite length_im_nparams, HPl in E0.
          assert (Hk : k < List.length Ps) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence); lia. }
        destruct HT0 as [T0 HT0]; exists T0; split; [ exact HT0 |].
        rewrite <- (tele_insts_sub_mvc (im_nparams Mj) (ind_nu D) σ0 _ σ Ps) in HT.
        + apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T1 & HT1 & ->); rewrite HT0 in HT1; injection HT1 as ->; reflexivity.
        + eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption.
        + exact (decl_nparams_mvc _ _ _ HD _ _ Hj).
        + eapply decl_closed_nparams_scoped; eassumption.
        + intros y Hy; unfold σ0; cbn [sb_of_wk sentry_sub wk_shiftn]; exact (Huc y Hy). }
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσσ) as Hσ'.
      apply wf_sub_eq_of_list_left; [ apply all_assumptions_sub; eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption | exact HN | apply wf_sub_eq_refl; exact Hβ
                                    | rewrite length_tele_sub, List.length_map, HPl; reflexivity
                                    | rewrite length_tele_sub, List.length_map, HPl; reflexivity | | |].
      - intros k N T HN1 HT.
        apply nth_error_map_inv in HN1 as (P & HPk & ->).
        destruct (Hinst _ _ _ HPk HT) as (T0 & HT0 & ->).
        exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HP _ _ _ HPk HT0) Hσ).
      - intros k N T HN2 HT.
        apply nth_error_map_inv in HN2 as (P & HPk & ->).
        destruct (Hinst _ _ _ HPk HT) as (T0 & HT0 & ->).
        pose proof (HP _ _ _ HPk HT0) as HP0; pose proof (proj2 (presup_exp HP0)) as HT0w;
          inversion HT0w as [? S0 HS0 HT0t | ?]; subst;
          
at the sort LevelSort, which every substitution keeps
          [| exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HP0 Hσ') ].
        eapply wf_conv_sort;
          [ exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HP0 Hσ') | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HT0t HS0 Hσ) | exact HS0 |].
        apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HT0t HS0 Hσσ).
      - intros k N N' T HN1 HN2 HT.
        apply nth_error_map_inv in HN1 as (P & HPk & ->).
        apply nth_error_map_inv in HN2 as (P1 & HPk1 & ->); rewrite HPk in HPk1; injection HPk1 as <-.
        destruct (Hinst _ _ _ HPk HT) as (T0 & HT0 & ->).
        exact (proj1 sub_eq_preserves_mut _ _ _ _ _ (HP _ _ _ HPk HT0) _ _ _ Hσσ). }
    assert (HM' : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ) by exact HM.
    unfold elim_mctx in HM'; cbn [List.app] in HM'; destruct (ctx_decomp_sort_kind HM') as [_ (S & HSk & Hi)].
    pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HSk) as HS.
    rewrite !sb_of_list_app; cbn [sb_of_list]; unfold elim_mctx; cbn [List.app].
    pose proof Hx as Hx'.
    rewrite <- (ind_head_inst p D j Mj Us (List.map (fun P => P[σ]) Ps) β) in Hx' by (try assumption; rewrite List.length_map; exact HPl).
    pose proof (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hi HS Hnn) as Hhh.
    eapply wf_sub_eq_extend;
      [ exact Hnn | exact Hi | exact HSk | exact Hx'
      | eapply wf_conv_sort;
          [ exact Hx' | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hi HS (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hnn)) | exact HS | exact Hhh ]
      | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact Hx' ].
  Qed.

The same terms after equal substitutions, filling the same telescope, are equal substitutions.
  Lemma wf_sub_eq_of_list_same : forall Ψ Δ Γ0 σ σ' Ms,
      all_assumptions Δ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ0 -> List.length Ms = List.length Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ0 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list σ Ms : Δ ++ Γ0 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list σ Ms ≈ sb_of_list σ' Ms : Δ ++ Γ0.
  Proof.
    intros * Hass HΔ Hl Hσσ Hσ.
    pose proof (wf_sub_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hass Hl Hσ) as HMs.
    eapply wf_sub_eq_of_list_left; [ exact Hass | exact HΔ | exact Hσσ | exact Hl | exact Hl | exact HMs | exact HMs |].
    intros k N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HMs _ _ _ HN HT).
  Qed.

The type of a recursive result along a leaf path of a shape, at equal substitutions of the shape's components: along the same walk as leaf_walk, by the rank of the record view the shape ends in.
  Lemma leaf_ihty_sub_eq : forall Γ p D Us As r i,
      ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> decls_typed Θ Ξ -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ) ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> elim_mctx_head_large Θ Ξ Γ p D j Mj Us) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      forall n Mk Bs1 Tb t Ψ β σ σ' x Mj l,
      (im_is_rview Mj = true -> ptyp_mem t < n) ->
      ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj -> List.length (ptyp_ps t) = im_nn Mj ->
      shape_doms_typed Θ Ξ D Mk Bs1 Tb t -> shape_leaf_typed Θ Ξ D Mk Mj Bs1 Tb t ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ β : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ : doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk ->
      shape_uc D Us (doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk) σ β ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ x : ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) σ t ->
      In l (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (List.length Bs1 + List.length Tb + im_nn Mk) t) ->
      exists j, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ leaf_ihty r As β σ x l ≈ leaf_ihty r As β σ' x l : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@j.
  Proof.
    intros Γ p D Us As r i Hg HDs Hl HUl HM HMh HA Hmk.
    pose proof (HDs _ _ Hl) as HD; pose proof (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) Hl) as Hc.
    intros n; induction n as [n IHn] using Wf_nat.lt_wf_ind.
    intros Mk Bs1 Tb t; revert Bs1; induction t as [j0 Ps | B t IH];
      intros Bs1 Ψ β σ σ' x Mj l Hrk Hj HPl HB HP Hβ Hσ Hσσ Huc Hx Hin; cbn [ptyp_mem ptyp_ps shape_leaves ptyp_ty_at] in *.
    - destruct (im_is_rview Mj) eqn:Hr.
      + (* a record view: through its fields *)
        specialize (Hrk eq_refl).
        destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc k' Is0 vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; unfold im_is_rview in Hr; rewrite Hh in Hr;
          try discriminate.
        destruct (rview_params _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hj Hh) as [EG Hnn].
        destruct Ps; [| cbn in HPl; lia ].
        destruct (rview_struct_con _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ HD) _ _ _ _ _ Hj Hh) as (gs & Hcs & Hlen).
        pose proof (leaves_coherent_of_order _ (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ HD))) as Hco.
        rewrite (Hco _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj Hh Hcs) in Hin.
        apply List.in_map_iff in Hin as (l0 & <- & Hin).
        rewrite !leaf_ihty_wk.
        set (m := List.length Bs1 + List.length Tb + im_nn Mk) in *.
        set (σ0 := ι (wk_shiftn m) ⨟ σ); set (σ0' := ι (wk_shiftn m) ⨟ σ').
        destruct (length_shape_ctx D Mk Bs1 Tb) as [Hlm Hle]; fold m in Hlm.
        assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk ⊢ʷ wk_shiftn m : im_params D Mj).
        { pose proof (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as HC; rewrite EG.
          replace m with (List.length ((doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb) ++ im_nparams Mk))
            by (unfold m; rewrite !List.length_app, length_doms_ctx; unfold im_nn; lia).
          replace (doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk) with (((doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb) ++ im_nparams Mk) ++ ind_uparams D)
            in HC |- * by (unfold im_params; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
          apply wf_wk_shiftn_app'; exact HC. }
        assert (Hσ0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ0 : im_params D Mj) by (eapply wf_sub_compose; [ apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hw | exact Hσ ]).
        assert (Hσσ0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ σ0 ≈ σ0' : im_params D Mj)
          by (eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_right; [ apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hw | exact Hσσ ]).
        assert (Huc0 : forall y, y < ind_nu D -> sentry_exp (σ0 y) = sentry_exp ((sb_of_list Id Us ⨟ β) y)).
        { intros y Hy; etransitivity; [| exact (Huc y Hy) ]; rewrite Hlm.
          unfold σ0; cbn [sb_compose sb_of_wk sentry_sub wk_shiftn]; reflexivity. }
        assert (Hx0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ x : apps_exp (a_record qr) (List.map (fun I => I[σ0]) Is)).
        { rewrite <- (rview_mty _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ _ (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) σ0 HD Hc Hj Hh); [ exact Hx |].
          intros y Hy; rewrite Huc0 by exact Hy; cbn [sb_compose].
          rewrite sb_of_list_lt_compose by lia; reflexivity. }
        apply fields_leaves_in in Hin as (fs1 & f & t & fs2 & l1 & Ec & -> & Hin1).
        cbn [leaf_ihty]; cbn [List.app] in Hin1 |- *.
        destruct (rview_field_arg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hj Hh Hcs Ec Hσ0 Hx0) as [Hτ Hxf].
        destruct (combine_split_at _ _ _ _ _ _ (eq_sym Hlen) Ec) as [Efl Egs].
        set (gs1 := List.map snd fs1) in *.
        set (τ := sb_of_list σ0 (projections_of (List.map fst fs1) x)) in *.
        set (τ' := sb_of_list σ0' (projections_of (List.map fst fs1) x)).
        assert (Hin' : List.In (rview_con, gs) (im_cons Mj)) by (rewrite Hcs; left; reflexivity).
        destruct (decl_shape_facts _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hj Hin' Egs) as (Mt & Ht & HPlt & HBt & HPt).
        destruct (cargs_ctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hj Hin' gs1 _ Egs) as (HΨ1 & _ & Hφ).
        assert (Hττ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : cargs_ctx p D Mj gs1 ++ im_params D Mj).
        { apply wf_sub_eq_of_list_same; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact HΨ1 | | exact Hσσ0 | exact Hτ ].
          unfold gs1, projections_of; rewrite length_cargs_ctx, !List.length_map; reflexivity. }
        assert (E1 : forall σx, sb_eq (ι (wk_pat (cargs_pat gs1)) ⨟ sb_of_list σx (projections_of (List.map fst fs1) x))
                                       (sb_of_list σx (projections_of (fields_args fs1) x))).
        { intros σx; pose proof (wk_pat_projections fs1 nil σx x) as E; rewrite List.app_nil_r in E.
          etransitivity; [ exact E |]; apply sb_of_list_cong; intros z; reflexivity. }
        rewrite <- (leaf_ihty_sb_eq _ l1 _ β β _ _ _ (fun z => eq_refl) (E1 σ0)),
                <- (leaf_ihty_sb_eq _ l1 _ β β _ _ _ (fun z => eq_refl) (E1 σ0')).
        assert (Hlg : List.length (cargs_pat gs1) = List.length (projections_of (List.map fst fs1) x))
          by (unfold gs1, projections_of; rewrite length_cargs_pat, !List.length_map; reflexivity).
        assert (Huc1 : forall y, y < ind_nu D ->
                  sentry_exp (τ (y + (List.length (cargs_pat gs1) + im_nn Mj))) = sentry_exp ((sb_of_list Id Us ⨟ β) y)).
        { intros y Hy; rewrite Hnn, Nat.add_0_r, Nat.add_comm, Hlg; unfold τ; rewrite sb_of_list_ge; exact (Huc0 y Hy). }
        refine (IHn _ Hrk Mj nil (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) t Ψ β _ _ (a_proj f x) Mt l1 _ Ht HPlt HBt HPt Hβ _ _ _ _ _).
        * intros HrT; exact (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ HD) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj Hh Hcs Egs Ht HrT).
        * eapply wf_sub_compose; [ apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hφ | exact Hτ ].
        * eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_right; [ apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hφ | exact Hττ ].
        * intros y Hy; cbn [doms_ctx List.rev List.map List.app] in *.
          rewrite EG, List.length_app; cbn [sb_compose sb_of_wk sentry_sub].
          replace (y + (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + List.length (ind_uparams D) - ind_nu D))
            with (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + y) by (rewrite pat_nargs_cargs_pat; unfold ind_nu; lia).
          rewrite wk_pat_ge; cbn [sb_compose] in Huc1.
          rewrite <- (Huc1 y Hy), Hnn, Nat.add_0_r, Nat.add_comm; reflexivity.
        * rewrite ptyp_ty_eq_at, ptyp_ty_at_sub in Hxf by (try exact Hc; apply length_ind_uvars).
          rewrite (uvars_inst _ _ _ _ _ _ HUl Huc1) in Hxf; exact Hxf.
        * cbn [List.length]; rewrite Hnn, Nat.add_0_r.
          replace (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1)) with (List.length (fields_args fs1)); [ exact Hin1 |].
          unfold gs1; rewrite length_fields_args; reflexivity.
      + rewrite (rview_leaves_not_rview _ _ _ Hj Hr) in Hin; destruct Hin as [<- | []].
        cbn [leaf_ihty]; exists i.
        exact (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HA _ _ Hj Hr) (type_sort_abs_kind r _ (type_sort_universe i))
                 (ih_leaf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hc Hj HUl (HM _ _ Hj) Hβ Hσ Hσσ Huc HPl
                    (shape_leaf_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HP eq_refl) Hx)).
    - apply List.in_map_iff in Hin as (l' & <- & Hin).
      destruct (HB nil B (ptyp_doms t) eq_refl) as [j1 Hj1]; rewrite List.app_nil_r in Hj1.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj1 Hσ) as Hj1'; cbn [exp_sub] in Hj1'.
      pose proof (sub_eq_preserves_typ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj1 Hσσ) as HBB.
      assert (HΨ' : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ▹{ak_relevant} B[σ]) by (eapply wf_ctx_extend; [ exact Hj1' | apply sort_kind_universe ]).
      pose proof (wf_sub_q _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ Hj1 (sort_kind_universe _) Hj1') as Hσ'.
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_q _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσσ Hj1 (sort_kind_universe _) HBB) as Hσσ'.
      assert (Hβ' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ▹{ak_relevant} B[σ] ⊢ˢ β ⨟ ι ↑ : Γ)
        by (eapply wf_sub_compose; [ exact Hβ | apply wf_sub_of_wk, wf_wk_shift; exact HΨ' ]).
      replace ((doms_ctx Bs1 ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk) ▹{ak_relevant} B) with (doms_ctx (Bs1 ++ B :: nil) ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk) in Hσ', Hσσ'
        by (rewrite doms_ctx_app_one; reflexivity).
      assert (Huc' : shape_uc D Us (doms_ctx (Bs1 ++ B :: nil) ++ Tb ++ im_params D Mk) (q σ) (β ⨟ ι ↑))
        by (rewrite doms_ctx_app_one; apply shape_uc_pi; [ exact (proj2 (length_shape_ctx D Mk Bs1 Tb)) | exact Huc ]).
      pose proof (shape_doms_typed_pi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB) as HB''.
      pose proof (shape_leaf_typed_pi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HP) as HP''.
      assert (Hus : List.map (fun U => U[↑]ʷ) (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) = List.map (fun U => U[β ⨟ ι ↑]) Us)
        by (rewrite List.map_map; apply List.map_ext; intros; rewrite <- exp_sub_of_wk, exp_sub_sub; reflexivity).
      rewrite Hus in Hx.
      destruct (ty_at_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hc HUl HM HMh Hβ' Hσ' Huc' Hj HPl HB'' HP'') as [j2 Hj2].
      pose proof (shape_arg_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj1' Hj2 Hx) as Hx'.
      destruct (IH (Bs1 ++ B :: nil) _ _ _ _ _ _ l' Hrk Hj HPl HB'' HP'' Hβ' Hσ' Hσσ' Huc' Hx')
        as (j3 & H3).
      { rewrite List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; replace (List.length Bs1 + 1 + List.length Tb + im_nn Mk)
          with (S (List.length Bs1 + List.length Tb + im_nn Mk)) by lia; exact Hin. }
      exists (max j1 j3); cbn [leaf_ihty].
      eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_at_max; [ exact Hj1' | exact HBB | exact H3 | apply motive_kind_pi_kinds; exact Hmk ].
  Qed.

The components of a recursive argument in a branch's context, at equal uniform parameters.
  Lemma ihs_sub_us_eq : forall Γ p D k Mk Us Us' c gs gs1 t gs2 E,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      List.In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs ⊢ˢ ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E)
        ≈ ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us' (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E) : doms_ctx nil ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ Hσσ Hin Heq HΨ.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    set (pat := cargs_pat gs1) in *.
    assert (Hpat : List.length pat = List.length gs1) by apply length_cargs_pat.
    set (i := List.length pat) in *.
    set (j := List.length E) in *.
    set (na := List.length gs) in *.
    set (s := na - i + j).
    set (ρ := sb_qn (i + im_nn Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us)).
    set (ρ' := sb_qn (i + im_nn Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us')).
    destruct (cargs_ctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hin gs1 (ca_rec t :: gs2) Heq) as (HΨ1 & _ & Hφ).
    assert (Hw3 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs ⊢ʷ wk_shiftn s : con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs1).
    { rewrite Heq in HΨ |- *; rewrite con_inst_ctx_split in HΨ |- *; rewrite List.app_assoc in HΨ |- *.
      match goal with |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?L ++ _ ⊢ʷ wk_shiftn ?n : _ => replace n with (List.length L) end.
      - apply wf_wk_shiftn_app'; exact HΨ.
      - rewrite !List.length_app, length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx_aux; cbn; unfold s, na, i, j; rewrite Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia. }
    assert (Hτ2e : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs1 ⊢ˢ ρ ≈ ρ' : cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ++ Γ).
    { assert (HΨΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk) ++ Γ).
      { apply wf_ctx_closed_app; [| eapply cargs_ctx_closed; eassumption | exact HΨ1 | exact HΓ ].
        apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_params_ass; eassumption ]. }
      unfold im_params in HΨΓ; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc, (List.app_assoc (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1)) in HΨΓ.
      assert (Hass1 : all_assumptions (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_nparams Mk))
        by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]).
      pose proof (sb_qn_eq_ext _ _ _ _ _ Hass1 HΨΓ Hσσ) as H.
      rewrite <- con_inst_ctx_eq in H; rewrite List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams in H.
      rewrite <- Hpat in H; fold i ρ ρ' in H.
      unfold im_params; rewrite <- (List.app_assoc (im_nparams Mk)), List.app_assoc; exact H. }
    change (ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us na pat j) with ((ι (wk_pat pat) ⨟ ρ) ⨟ ι (wk_shiftn s)).
    change (ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us' na pat j) with ((ι (wk_pat pat) ⨟ ρ') ⨟ ι (wk_shiftn s)).
    cbn [doms_ctx List.rev List.map List.app].
    eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_left; [| apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hw3 ].
    eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_right; [ apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hφ |].
    rewrite List.app_assoc in Hτ2e; exact (wf_sub_eq_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hτ2e HΨ1).
  Qed.

The type of the recursive result of a recursive argument, in a branch's context, at equal uniform parameters.
  Lemma rec_ih_us_eq : forall Γ p D k Mk Us Us' As r i c gs gs1 t gs2 E l,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      List.In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      In l (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + im_nn Mk) t) ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs ->
      let T V := leaf_ihty r As (ι (wk_shiftn (List.length E + List.length gs + im_nn Mk)))
                   (ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) V (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E))
                   (a_var (List.length E + List.length gs - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1))) l in
      exists j, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs ⊢ T Us ≈ T Us' : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@j.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ Hσσ HM HA Hmk Hin Heq Hinl HΨ T.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    destruct (rec_arg_inst _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ Hin Heq HΨ) as (Hb & Hθ & Huc & Hx).
    destruct (decl_shape_facts _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk Hin Heq) as (Mj & Hj & HPl & HBt & HPt).
    pose proof (ihs_sub_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ Hσσ Hin Heq HΨ) as Hθθ.
    assert (HMh : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> elim_mctx_head_large Θ Ξ Γ p D j Mj Us)
      by (intros; eapply elim_mctx_head_wf_sub; eassumption).
    eapply (leaf_ihty_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl HUl HM HMh HA Hmk (S (ptyp_mem t))); try eassumption.
    - intros _; lia.
    - cbn [List.length]; rewrite <- pat_nargs_cargs_pat; exact Hinl.
  Qed.

The induction hypotheses of a leaf list are assumptions.
  Lemma all_assumptions_leaves_ctx : forall r nn As Us na pat ls j, all_assumptions (leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat j ls).
  Proof.
    induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros j; cbn [leaves_ctx]; [ constructor |].
    apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply IH | constructor; [ do 2 eexists; reflexivity | constructor ] ].
  Qed.

  Lemma ihs_ctx_us_eq : forall Γ p D k Mk Us Us' As r i c gs,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ) ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us' ++ Γ) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      List.In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) ->
      forall rest gs1 E E', gs = gs1 ++ rest -> List.length E = cargs_nrec D gs1 -> List.length E' = cargs_nrec D gs1 ->
        all_assumptions E ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ E ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ≈ E' ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ ihs_ctx_aux r (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E) rest
                       ++ E ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs
                 ≈ ihs_ctx_aux r (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk) As Us' (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E) rest
                       ++ E' ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ Hσ' Hσσ HM HM' HA HA' Hmk Hin rest.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [_ Hc].
The arguments of a constructor instance are assumptions.
    assert (Hcta : all_assumptions (con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs)).
    { assert (Hct : con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs = tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us))
        by (unfold con_inst_tele; rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams; reflexivity).
      rewrite Hct; apply all_assumptions_sub, List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]. }
    assert (HAA : motives_eq Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As As r i) by (intros j Mj Hj Hr; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HA _ _ Hj Hr)).
    assert (HAA' : motives_eq Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' As As r i) by (intros j Mj Hj Hr; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HA' _ _ Hj Hr)).
    induction rest as [| [rB B | t] rest IH]; intros gs1 E E' Heq HE HE' HaE HEE; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app]; [ exact HEE | |].
    - replace (false :: cargs_pat gs1) with (cargs_pat (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B :: nil)) by (rewrite cargs_pat_snoc; reflexivity).
      apply IH; [ rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite cargs_nrec_snoc, HE; lia | rewrite cargs_nrec_snoc, HE'; lia
                | exact HaE | exact HEE ].
    - set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + im_nn Mk) t).
      (* the results along the leaf paths, one by one *)
      assert (HL : forall ls0 E0 E0', List.incl ls0 ls -> List.length E0 = List.length E0' -> all_assumptions E0 ->
                 Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ E0 ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ≈ E0' ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs ->
                 Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ (leaves_ctx r (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E0) ls0 ++ E0)
                                ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs
                              ≈ (leaves_ctx r (im_nn Mk) As Us' (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E0) ls0 ++ E0')
                                ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs).
      { intros ls0; induction ls0 as [| l ls0 IHl]; intros E0 E0' Hls HlE HaE0 HEE0; cbn [leaves_ctx List.app]; [ exact HEE0 |].
        assert (Hinl : In l ls) by (apply Hls; left; reflexivity).
        assert (HΨ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E0 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us gs)
          by (rewrite con_inst_ctx_con_inst_tele, List.app_assoc; eapply ext_eq_ctx_left; exact HEE0).
        assert (HΨ' : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ E0' ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mk Us' gs)
          by (rewrite con_inst_ctx_con_inst_tele, List.app_assoc; eapply ext_eq_ctx_right; exact HEE0).
        destruct (rec_ih_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E0 l Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ HM HA HA HAA Hmk Hin Heq Hinl HΨ)
          as (j1 & Hj & _).
        destruct (rec_ih_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E0' l Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ HUl' Hσ' HM' HA' HA' HAA' Hmk Hin Heq Hinl HΨ')
          as (j2 & Hj' & _).
        destruct (rec_ih_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E0 l Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ Hσσ HM HA Hmk Hin Heq Hinl HΨ) as (j3 & Hjj).
        cbv zeta in Hj, Hj', Hjj.
        rewrite <- HlE in Hj'.
        rewrite con_inst_ctx_con_inst_tele, List.app_assoc in Hj, Hj', Hjj.
        rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; cbn [List.app].
        change (S (List.length E0)) with (List.length (ce_ass r (leaf_ihty r As (ι (wk_shiftn (List.length E0 + List.length gs + im_nn Mk)))
                                            (ihs_sub (im_nn Mk) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E0))
                                            (a_var (List.length E0 + List.length gs - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1))) l) :: E0)).
        rewrite !List.app_comm_cons, !List.app_assoc; apply IHl;
          [ intros l' Hl'; apply Hls; right; exact Hl' | cbn; lia | constructor; [ do 2 eexists; reflexivity | exact HaE0 ] |].
        cbn [List.app]; eapply wf_ext_eq_ass_of_exp_eq;
          [ exact HEE0 | apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HaE0 | exact Hcta ]
          | exact (lift_rel_ge _ _ _ _ _ j1 (max j1 (max j2 j3)) ltac:(lia) Hj)
          | apply sort_kind_abs_kind_sort
          | exact (lift_rel_eq_ge _ _ _ _ _ _ j3 (max j1 (max j2 j3)) ltac:(lia) Hjj)
          | exact (lift_rel_ge _ _ _ _ _ j2 (max j1 (max j2 j3)) ltac:(lia) Hj') ]. }
      pose proof (HL ls E E' (List.incl_refl _) ltac:(lia) HaE HEE) as HL'.
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc.
      replace (true :: cargs_pat gs1) with (cargs_pat (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil)) by (rewrite cargs_pat_snoc; reflexivity).
      set (L := leaves_ctx r (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E) ls) in *.
      set (L' := leaves_ctx r (im_nn Mk) As Us' (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (List.length E) ls) in *.
      replace (List.length ls + List.length E) with (List.length (L ++ E))
        by (unfold L; rewrite List.length_app, length_leaves_ctx; reflexivity).
      rewrite <- !List.app_assoc, (List.app_assoc L E), (List.app_assoc L' E').
      apply IH; [ rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | | | apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply all_assumptions_leaves_ctx | exact HaE ]
                | exact HL' ];
        unfold L, L', ls; rewrite List.length_app, length_leaves_ctx, cargs_nrec_snoc, ?HE, ?HE', (length_shape_leaves _ _ _ 0); lia.
  Qed.

The Branches' Contexts


  Lemma elim_bctx_us_eq : forall Γ p D k Mk Us Us' As r i c gs,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ) ->
      (forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us' ++ Γ) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ≈ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ Hσ' Hσσ HM HM' HA HA' Hmk Hcon.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    pose proof (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) as Hin.
    assert (Hct : forall V, con_inst_tele p D Mk V gs = tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id V))
      by (intros; unfold con_inst_tele; rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams; reflexivity).
    assert (H0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ nil ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ≈ nil ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs).
    { cbn [List.app]; rewrite !Hct.
      destruct (cargs_ctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hin gs nil (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) as (HΨ1 & _ & _).
      assert (HΨΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk) ++ Γ).
      { apply wf_ctx_closed_app; [| exact (cargs_ctx_closed p D k Mk c gs gs nil Hc Hk Hin (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) | exact HΨ1 | exact HΓ ].
        apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_params_ass; eassumption ]. }
      unfold im_params in HΨΓ; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc, (List.app_assoc (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs)) in HΨΓ.
      eapply tele_sub_eq_ext; [| exact HΨΓ | exact Hσσ ].
      apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]. }
    pose proof (ihs_ctx_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ Hσ' Hσσ HM HM' HA HA' Hmk Hin gs nil nil nil eq_refl eq_refl eq_refl (List.Forall_nil _) H0) as H.
    cbn [List.app List.length cargs_pat List.map List.rev] in H; unfold con_inst_tele in H; unfold elim_bctx; exact H.
  Qed.

The Branches' Types

The parameters and the arguments of a branch's context, as variables.
  Lemma bctx_base_typed : forall Γ p D k Mk Us As r i c gs,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j U T, nth_error Us j = Some U -> nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : T) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
      let n := im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs in
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ
        ⊢ˢ sb_of_list (ι (wk_shiftn n)) (vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs) (im_nn Mk) ++ vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs) (List.length gs))
        : con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ++ Γ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUs HA Hmk Hcon n.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    pose proof (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) as Hin.
    pose proof (wf_sub_uparams _ _ _ HD Hc _ _ HΓ HUl HUs) as Hσ.
    assert (HM : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ)
      by (intros j Mj Hj; exact (elim_mctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hj HΓ HUl HUs)).
    pose proof (elim_bctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ HM HA Hmk Hcon) as HΔ.
    destruct (wf_sub_cinst _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ Hσ c gs gs nil Hin (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) as [Hi _].
    rewrite con_inst_ctx_con_inst_tele in Hi.
    set (IHc := ihs_ctx_aux r (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs).
    assert (EΔ : elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ = IHc ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ++ Γ)
      by (unfold elim_bctx, con_inst_tele; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
    assert (HlI : List.length IHc = cargs_nrec D gs) by (unfold IHc; apply length_ihs_ctx_aux).
    assert (Hlc : List.length (con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs) = List.length gs + im_nn Mk)
      by (unfold con_inst_tele; rewrite List.length_app, !length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx; reflexivity).
    assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ ⊢ʷ wk_shiftn n : Γ).
    { rewrite EΔ, List.app_assoc; replace n with (List.length (IHc ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs))
        by (rewrite List.length_app, HlI, Hlc; unfold n; lia).
      apply wf_wk_shiftn_app'; rewrite <- List.app_assoc, <- EΔ; exact HΔ. }
    apply wf_sub_of_list; [ unfold con_inst_tele; apply List.Forall_app; split; apply all_assumptions_sub;
                              [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (decl_typed_nparams_ass _ _ _ HD _ _ Hk) ]
                          | exact Hi | apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hw
                          | rewrite List.length_app, !length_vars_from, Hlc; lia |].
    rewrite vars_from_app.
    assert (Ect : con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs = tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us))
      by (unfold con_inst_tele; rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams; reflexivity).
    intros j N T HN HT.
    rewrite Ect, tele_insts_tele_sub in HT.
    replace (im_nn Mk + List.length gs) with (List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk)) in HN, HT
      by (rewrite List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx; change (List.length (im_nparams Mk)) with (im_nn Mk); lia).
    replace (cargs_nrec D gs) with (List.length IHc) in HN, HT by exact HlI.
    rewrite EΔ, Ect.
    eapply (wf_vars_tele_gen _ _ IHc _ (sb_of_list Id Us) _ Γ (ind_nu D));
      [ apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (decl_typed_nparams_ass _ _ _ HD _ _ Hk) ]
      | apply List.Forall_app; split; [ eapply cargs_ctx_mvc; eassumption | exact (decl_nparams_mvc _ _ _ HD _ _ Hk) ]
      | apply ctx_scoped_app; split;
        [ rewrite length_im_nparams; eapply decl_closed_cargs_scoped; eassumption | eapply decl_closed_nparams_scoped; eassumption ]
      | rewrite <- Ect, <- EΔ; exact HΔ | | exact HN | exact HT ].
    intros y Hy; cbn [sb_compose]; rewrite <- sentry_exp_sub, exp_sub_of_wk; f_equal.
    rewrite List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, HlI; change (List.length (im_nparams Mk)) with (im_nn Mk).
    unfold n; f_equal; lia.
  Qed.

The instance of the motive's context the type of a branch substitutes, at equal uniform parameters: the constructor applied is equal, the member's own at a declared member, the container's at a view.
  Lemma wf_branch_type_sub_eq : forall Γ p D k Mk Us Us' As r i c gs,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_is_rview Mk = false -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j U T, nth_error Us j = Some U -> nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : T) ->
      List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j U T, nth_error Us' j = Some U -> nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us') j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : T) ->
      (forall j U U' T, nth_error Us j = Some U -> nth_error Us' j = Some U' ->
         nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U ≈ U' : T) ->
      motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us As r i -> motive_kind r ->
      ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
      let n := im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs in
      let ρ V := sb_of_list (ι (wk_shiftn n))
                   (vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs) (im_nn Mk) ++
                    apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p k Mk)) (snd (im_ref p k Mk)) c)
                      (im_pre Mk (List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn n]ʷ) V) ++
                       vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs) (im_nn Mk) ++ vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs) (List.length gs))
                    :: nil) in
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ ⊢ˢ ρ Us ≈ ρ Us' : elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hk Hrv HΓ HUl HUs HUl' HUs' HUU HA Hmk Hcon n ρ.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hg; pose proof (decls_of_ctx _ _ _ HΓ) as HDs.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    pose proof (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) as Hin.
    pose proof (wf_sub_uparams _ _ _ HD Hc _ _ HΓ HUl HUs) as Hσ.
    pose proof (wf_sub_uparams _ _ _ HD Hc _ _ HΓ HUl' HUs') as Hσ'.
    assert (HM : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ)
      by (intros j Mj Hj; exact (elim_mctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hj HΓ HUl HUs)).
    pose proof (elim_bctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk HΓ HUl Hσ HM HA Hmk Hcon) as HΔ.
    set (Δ := elim_bctx r p D Mk gs As Us ++ Γ) in *.
    set (nvars := vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs) (im_nn Mk)) in *.
    set (avars := vars_from (cargs_nrec D gs) (List.length gs)) in *.
    (* the base, at both uniform parameters *)
    pose proof (bctx_base_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUs HA Hmk Hcon) as Hb; cbv zeta in Hb; fold n nvars avars Δ in Hb.
    assert (Hσσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ).
    { eapply wf_sub_eq_of_list_conv; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact (wf_uparams_app _ _ _ HD Hc _ HΓ)
                                     | apply wf_sub_eq_refl, wf_sub_id, HΓ | exact HUl | exact HUl' | exact HUs | exact HUs' | exact HUU ]. }
    assert (Hct : forall V, con_inst_tele p D Mk V gs = tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id V))
      by (intros; unfold con_inst_tele; rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams; reflexivity).
    assert (Hctel : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs ≈ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us' gs).
    { rewrite !Hct.
      destruct (cargs_ctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hin gs nil (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) as (HΨ1 & _ & _).
      assert (HΨΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk) ++ Γ).
      { apply wf_ctx_closed_app; [| exact (cargs_ctx_closed p D k Mk c gs gs nil Hc Hk Hin (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) | exact HΨ1 | exact HΓ ].
        apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_params_ass; eassumption ]. }
      unfold im_params in HΨΓ; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc, (List.app_assoc (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs)) in HΨΓ.
      eapply tele_sub_eq_ext; [| exact HΨΓ | exact Hσσ ].
      apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]. }
    assert (Hcta : all_assumptions (con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs))
      by (rewrite Hct; apply all_assumptions_sub, List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]).
    pose proof (wf_sub_compose _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ctxsub_ext_rev _ _ _ _ _ Hctel Hcta) Hb) as Hb'.
    rewrite sb_compose_id_left in Hb'.
    assert (HNl : List.length nvars = im_nn Mk) by (unfold nvars; apply length_vars_from).
    assert (HAl : List.length avars = List.length gs) by (unfold avars; apply length_vars_from).
    destruct (con_inst_tele_args_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk Hin HUl HNl HAl Hb) as [HNs HAs].
    destruct (con_inst_tele_args_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk Hin HUl' HNl HAl Hb') as [HNs' HAs'].
    set (Usw := List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn n]ʷ) Us) in *.
    set (Usw' := List.map (fun U => U[wk_shiftn n]ʷ) Us') in *.
    (* the weakening past the branch's context *)
    assert (Hw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ʷ wk_shiftn n : Γ).
    { set (IHc := ihs_ctx_aux r (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk) As Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs).
      assert (EΔ : Δ = (IHc ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs) ++ Γ) by (unfold Δ, elim_bctx, con_inst_tele; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      assert (Hlen : List.length (IHc ++ con_inst_tele p D Mk Us gs) = n).
      { unfold IHc, con_inst_tele; rewrite !List.length_app, length_ihs_ctx_aux, !length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx.
        change (List.length (im_nparams Mk)) with (im_nn Mk); unfold n; lia. }
      rewrite EΔ, <- Hlen; apply wf_wk_shiftn_app'; rewrite <- EΔ; exact HΔ. }
    pose proof (uparams_wk_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hw HUs) as HUsw; fold Usw in HUsw.
    pose proof (uparams_wk_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hw HUs') as HUsw'; fold Usw' in HUsw'.
    assert (HUlw : List.length Usw = ind_nu D) by (unfold Usw; rewrite List.length_map; exact HUl).
    assert (HUlw' : List.length Usw' = ind_nu D) by (unfold Usw'; rewrite List.length_map; exact HUl').
    assert (HUUw : forall j U U' T, nth_error Usw j = Some U -> nth_error Usw' j = Some U' ->
               nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Usw) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ U ≈ U' : T).
    { intros j U0 U0' T' HU HU' HT; unfold Usw, Usw' in *.
      rewrite <- tele_insts_closed_wk in HT by (first [ exact (decl_uparams_ass D Hc) | exact (decl_uparams_closed D Hc) ]).
      apply nth_error_map_inv in HU as (U & HU & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HU' as (U1 & HU1 & ->);
        apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T & HT & ->).
      exact (wk_preserves_exp_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HUU _ _ _ _ HU HU1 HT) Hw). }
    (* the constructors, equal *)
    assert (Hcc : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p k Mk)) (snd (im_ref p k Mk)) c) (im_pre Mk Usw ++ nvars ++ avars)
                   ≈ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p k Mk)) (snd (im_ref p k Mk)) c) (im_pre Mk Usw' ++ nvars ++ avars)
                   : ind_mty p D k (List.map (fun U => U[ι (wk_shiftn n)]) Us) nvars).
    { rewrite map_sub_of_wk; fold Usw.
      unfold ind_mty; rewrite Hk; unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre.
      unfold im_is_rview in Hrv.
      destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc k' Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; cbn [fst snd]; [| | discriminate ].
      - (* a declared member: its own constructor *)
        pose proof (member_decl_lt _ _ _ _ _ _ HD Hk Hh) as Hlt.
        pose proof (params_typed_join _ _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ _ Hk HUlw HUsw HNs) as HPs.
        pose proof (params_typed_join _ _ _ Hc _ _ _ _ _ Hk HUlw' HUsw' HNs') as HPs'.
        assert (HPl : List.length (Usw ++ nvars) = im_np D Mk) by (rewrite List.length_app, HUlw, HNl; unfold im_np; lia).
        assert (HPl' : List.length (Usw' ++ nvars) = im_np D Mk) by (rewrite List.length_app, HUlw', HNl; unfold im_np; lia).
        assert (HPP : forall j N N' T, nth_error (Usw ++ nvars) j = Some N -> nth_error (Usw' ++ nvars) j = Some N' ->
                   nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mk) Id (Usw ++ nvars)) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T).
        { unfold im_params; apply list_eq_app; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact HUlw | exact HUlw' | exact HUUw |].
          intros j N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HNs _ _ _ HN HT). }
        assert (HAA : forall j N N' T, nth_error avars j = Some N -> nth_error avars j = Some N' ->
                   nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Usw ++ nvars)) avars) j = Some T ->
                   Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T).
        { intros j N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HAs _ _ _ HN HT). }
        pose proof (con_apps_conv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hlt Hcon HΔ HPl HPl' HAl HAl HPs HPs' HPP HAs HAs' HAA) as H.
        rewrite firstn_app_len, skipn_app_len in H by exact HUlw.
        unfold ind_mty in H; rewrite Hk in H; unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre in H; rewrite Hh in H; cbn [fst snd] in H.
        rewrite !List.app_assoc; exact H.
      - (* a view: the container's constructor, at the view's instances *)
        destruct (view_con_inst_of _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hh Hcon HΔ HUlw HUsw HNl HNs HAl HAs)
          as [D3 Mk3 gs3 Hl3 Hk3 Hlt3 Hcon3 HPl3 HAl3 HPs3 HAs3].
        destruct (view_con_inst_of _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hh Hcon HΔ HUlw' HUsw' HNl HNs' HAl HAs')
          as [D4 Mk4 gs4 Hl4 Hk4 Hlt4 Hcon4 HPl4 HAl4 HPs4 HAs4].
        rewrite Hl3 in Hl4; injection Hl4 as <-; rewrite Hk3 in Hk4; injection Hk4 as <-; rewrite Hcon3 in Hcon4; injection Hcon4 as <-.
        pose proof (HDs _ _ Hl3) as HD3; pose proof (gctx_closed_ind _ _ _ _ (wf_gstack_closed _ _ Hg) Hl3) as Hc3.
        assert (Hσw : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Usw ≈ sb_of_list Id Usw' : ind_uparams D).
        { rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r (ind_uparams D)).
          eapply wf_sub_eq_of_list_conv; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact (decl_typed_uparams_field _ _ _ HD)
                                         | apply wf_sub_eq_refl, wf_sub_to_nil, HΔ | exact HUlw | exact HUlw'
                                         | exact HUsw | exact HUsw' | exact HUUw ]. }
        destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ HD _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) as (D0 & Mk0 & Hl0 & _ & _ & HIl & _).
        rewrite Hl3 in Hl0; injection Hl0 as <-.
        set (Ps := List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Usw]) Is ++ nvars) in *.
        set (Ps' := List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Usw']) Is ++ nvars) in *.
        assert (HPP : forall j N N' T, nth_error Ps j = Some N -> nth_error Ps' j = Some N' ->
                   nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D3 Mk3) Id Ps) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T).
        { unfold Ps, Ps', im_params; apply list_eq_app;
            [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc3) | rewrite List.length_map; exact HIl | rewrite List.length_map; exact HIl | |].
          - intros j N N' T HN HN' HT.
            rewrite <- (tele_insts_sub (ind_uparams D3) 0 Id Id (sb_of_list Id Usw) Is (decl_closed_ass _ Hc3) (decl_closed_uparams _ Hc3)
                          ltac:(intros; lia)) in HT.
            apply nth_error_map_inv in HN as (I & HI & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HN' as (I1 & HI1 & ->).
            rewrite HI in HI1; injection HI1 as <-.
            apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T0 & HT0 & ->).
            exact (sub_eq_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ (decl_typed_view_is _ _ _ _ Hg HD Hl _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh Hl3 HI HT0) _ _ _ Hσw).
          - intros j N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; apply wf_exp_eq_refl.
            apply (HPs3 (List.length (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Usw]) Is) + j)).
            + unfold Ps; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by lia; replace (_ + j - _) with j by lia; exact HN.
            + unfold Ps, im_params; rewrite tele_insts_app by (try exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc3); rewrite List.length_map; exact HIl).
              rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc3); rewrite !List.length_map; unfold ind_nu in *; lia).
              rewrite length_tele_insts by exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc3); rewrite !List.length_map.
              replace (List.length Is + j - Nat.min (List.length (ind_uparams D3)) (List.length Is)) with j
                by (unfold ind_nu in *; lia).
              exact HT. }
        assert (HAA : forall j N N' T, nth_error avars j = Some N -> nth_error avars j = Some N' ->
                   nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx qc D3 Mk3 gs3) (sb_of_list Id Ps) avars) j = Some T ->
                   Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T).
        { intros j N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (HAs3 _ _ _ HN HT). }
        pose proof (con_apps_conv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ps Ps' avars avars Hg HDs Hl3 Hk3 Hlt3 Hcon3 HΔ HPl3 HPl4 HAl3 HAl4
                      HPs3 HPs4 HPP HAs3 HAs4 HAA) as H.
        destruct (member_lt_decl _ _ _ _ _ HD3 Hk3 Hlt3) as [pm Hpm].
        unfold ind_mty in H; rewrite Hk3 in H; unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre in H; rewrite Hpm in H; cbn [fst snd] in H.
        rewrite List.firstn_skipn in H.
        unfold Ps, Ps' in H; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in H; exact H. }
    (* the substitutions *)
    pose proof (wf_branch_type_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hrv HΓ HUl HUs HM HA Hmk Hcon) as Hρ; fold n nvars avars Usw Δ in Hρ.
    set (conU := apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p k Mk)) (snd (im_ref p k Mk)) c) (im_pre Mk Usw ++ nvars ++ avars)) in *.
    set (conU' := apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p k Mk)) (snd (im_ref p k Mk)) c) (im_pre Mk Usw' ++ nvars ++ avars)) in *.
    unfold ρ; fold Usw Usw' conU conU'.
    assert (Hlen : forall x, List.length (nvars ++ x :: nil) = List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk Us))
      by (intros; rewrite List.length_app, length_elim_mctx, HNl; cbn; lia).
    pose proof (wf_sub_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (elim_mctx_ass _ _ _ _ Us Hc Hk) (Hlen conU) Hρ) as HMs.
    pose proof (fun x => elim_mctx_insts p D k Mk Us (ι wk_shiftn n) nvars x Hc Hk HUl HNl) as E.
    assert (Hl2 : List.length (tele_insts (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us ⨟ ι wk_shiftn n) nvars) = im_nn Mk)
      by (rewrite length_tele_insts by (eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption); rewrite HNl; unfold im_nn; lia).
    (* the right constructor, at the type of the left one: the member's types
       at the two uniform parameters are equal, the heads of the motive's
       contexts *)
    assert (Hcon' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ conU' : ind_mty p D k (List.map (fun U => U[ι (wk_shiftn n)]) Us) nvars).
    { pose proof (wf_con_apps_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg HDs Hl Hk Hrv Hcon HΔ HUlw' HUsw' HNl HNs' HAl HAs') as H'.
      fold conU' in H'.
      destruct (elim_mctx_head_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσσ) as [S HSk _ Hhd Hhh _].
      pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HSk) as HS.
      assert (HNΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ)
        by (pose proof (HM _ _ Hk) as H0; unfold elim_mctx in H0; cbn [List.app] in H0; exact (proj1 (ctx_decomp H0))).
      assert (Hδ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list (ι (wk_shiftn n)) nvars : tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ).
      { apply wf_sub_of_list; [ apply all_assumptions_sub; eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption | exact HNΓ
                              | apply wf_sub_of_wk; exact Hw | rewrite length_tele_sub, HNl; reflexivity |].
        intros j0 N T HN HT; rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub in HT.
        apply (HMs j0); [ rewrite List.nth_error_app1 by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence); exact HN |].
        rewrite E, List.nth_error_app1 by (rewrite Hl2, <- HNl; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence); exact HT. }
      pose proof (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hhd HS Hδ) as HT1.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_sort_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hhh HS Hδ) as HTT.
      rewrite !ind_head_inst in HT1, HTT by first [ exact Hc | exact HUl | exact HUl' | exact HNl ].
      rewrite (ind_head_inst p D k Mk Us' nvars (ι (wk_shiftn n)) Hc HUl' HNl) in HTT.
      assert (EU : Usw' = List.map (fun U => U[ι (wk_shiftn n)]) Us') by (unfold Usw'; symmetry; apply map_sub_of_wk).
      rewrite EU in H'.
      eapply wf_conv_sort; [ exact H' | exact HT1 | exact HS | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact HTT ]. }
    eapply wf_sub_eq_of_list_left; [ exact (elim_mctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk) | exact (HM _ _ Hk) | apply wf_sub_eq_refl, wf_sub_of_wk, Hw
                                   | exact (Hlen conU) | exact (Hlen conU') | exact HMs | |].
    - intros j N T HN HT; rewrite E in HT.
      destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases j (im_nn Mk)) as [Hj | Hj].
      + rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HN by lia.
        apply (HMs j); [ rewrite List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN | rewrite E; exact HT ].
      + rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HN by lia; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HT by lia.
        rewrite HNl in HN; rewrite Hl2 in HT.
        destruct (j - im_nn Mk) as [| j0] eqn:Hj0; cbn in HN, HT; [| destruct j0; discriminate ].
        injection HN as <-; injection HT as <-; exact Hcon'.
    - intros j N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite E in HT.
      destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases j (im_nn Mk)) as [Hj | Hj].
      + rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HN, HN' by lia; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-.
        apply wf_exp_eq_refl; apply (HMs j); [ rewrite List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN | rewrite E; exact HT ].
      + rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HN, HN' by lia; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HT by lia.
        rewrite HNl in HN, HN'; rewrite Hl2 in HT.
        destruct (j - im_nn Mk) as [| j0] eqn:Hj0; cbn in HN, HN', HT; [| destruct j0; discriminate ].
        injection HN as <-; injection HN' as <-; injection HT as <-; exact Hcc.
  Qed.

Equal Instances of a Telescope

Equal substitutions read back from lists of terms: equal terms, each at the instance of the type of its variable.
  Lemma wf_sub_eq_of_list_inv : forall Γ Δ Γ0 σ σ' Ms Ms',
      all_assumptions Δ -> List.length Ms = List.length Δ -> List.length Ms' = List.length Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list σ Ms ≈ sb_of_list σ' Ms' : Δ ++ Γ0 ->
      forall k N N' T, List.nth_error Ms k = Some N -> List.nth_error Ms' k = Some N' ->
        List.nth_error (tele_insts Δ σ Ms) k = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T.
  Proof.
    intros * Hass Hl Hl' Hσ k N N' T HN HN' HT.
    apply tele_insts_nth in HT as (κ & A & HA & ->).
    destruct (List.nth_error_split _ _ HA) as (l1 & l2 & Hrev & Hl1).
    assert (HΔeq : Δ = List.rev l2 ++ ce_ass κ A :: List.rev l1)
      by (rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive Δ), Hrev, List.rev_app_distr; cbn [List.rev]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
    assert (Hlen : List.length Δ = List.length l2 + S k)
      by (rewrite HΔeq, List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; rewrite !List.length_rev; lia).
    assert (Hlk : Δ ++ Γ0 ∋ #(List.length l2) : A[wk_shiftn (List.length l2 + 1)]ʷ).
    { rewrite HΔeq, <- List.app_assoc.
      replace (List.length l2) with (0 + List.length (List.rev l2)) at 1 by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
      replace (A[wk_shiftn (List.length l2 + 1)]ʷ) with (A[↑]ʷ[wk_shiftn (List.length (List.rev l2))]ʷ).
      - apply ctx_lookup_app_r; constructor.
      - rewrite exp_wk_wk; apply exp_wk_wk_eq; intros x; cbn; rewrite List.length_rev; lia. }
    pose proof (wf_sub_eq_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ _ _ Hlk) as H.
    change (exp_sub (a_var ?x) ?s) with (sentry_exp (s x)) in H.
    rewrite (sb_of_list_nth _ _ _ N) in H by lia.
    rewrite (sb_of_list_nth _ _ _ N') in H by lia.
    replace (List.length Ms - 1 - List.length l2) with k in H by lia.
    replace (List.length Ms' - 1 - List.length l2) with k in H by lia.
    rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HN), (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HN') in H; cbn in H.
    replace (A[sb_of_list σ (List.firstn k Ms)]) with (A[wk_shiftn (List.length l2 + 1)]ʷ[sb_of_list σ Ms]); [ exact H |].
    rewrite exp_sub_wk; apply exp_sub_sb_eq; intros x; cbn [sb_compose sb_of_wk sentry_sub wk_shiftn].
    rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn k Ms) at 1; rewrite sb_of_list_app.
    replace (x + (List.length l2 + 1)) with (List.length (List.skipn k Ms) + x) by (rewrite List.length_skipn; lia).
    rewrite sb_of_list_ge; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Lemma wf_sub_eq_sb_eq : forall Γ Δ σ1 σ1' σ2 σ2', sb_eq σ1 σ2 -> sb_eq σ1' σ2' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ1 ≈ σ1' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ2 ≈ σ2' : Δ.
  Proof.
    intros * E E' [Hl0 Hr0 Ha Hm]; constructor.
    - rewrite <- E; exact Hl0.
    - rewrite <- E'; exact Hr0.
    - intros x A Hx; rewrite <- !(exp_sub_sb_eq _ _ _ E), <- (exp_sub_sb_eq _ _ _ E'); exact (Ha _ _ Hx).
    - intros x U Hx; rewrite <- (E x), <- (E' x); exact (Hm _ _ Hx).
  Qed.

Equal parameters of a member: equal uniform ones, and equal non-uniform ones at the instances at the first uniform ones.
  Lemma params_eq_split : forall Γ D k Mk Ps Ps', decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      List.length Ps = im_np D Mk -> List.length Ps' = im_np D Mk ->
      (forall j P P' T, List.nth_error Ps j = Some P -> List.nth_error Ps' j = Some P' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mk) Id Ps) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ P ≈ P' : T) ->
      (forall j U U' T, List.nth_error (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) j = Some U -> List.nth_error (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps') j = Some U' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U ≈ U' : T) /\
      (forall j N N' T, List.nth_error (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) j = Some N -> List.nth_error (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps') j = Some N' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps)) j = Some T ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T).
  Proof.
    intros * Hc Hk Hl Hl' HPs.
    assert (HUl : List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) = ind_nu D) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in Hl; lia).
    assert (HUl' : List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps') = ind_nu D) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in Hl'; lia).
    assert (Hti : tele_insts (im_params D Mk) Id Ps
                  = tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)
                    ++ tele_insts (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps)).
    { rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) at 1; unfold im_params; apply tele_insts_app;
        [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact HUl ]. }
    assert (Hl2 : List.length (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) = ind_nu D)
      by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc); rewrite HUl; unfold ind_nu; lia).
    split; intros j N N' T HN HN' HT.
    - assert (Hj : j < ind_nu D) by (rewrite <- HUl; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
      apply (HPs j);
        [ rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps), List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN
        | rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps'), List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN'
        | rewrite Hti, List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HT ].
    - apply (HPs (ind_nu D + j)).
      + rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) at 1; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by lia.
        rewrite HUl; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HN.
      + rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps') at 1; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by lia.
        rewrite HUl'; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HN'.
      + rewrite Hti, List.nth_error_app2 by lia; rewrite Hl2; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HT.
  Qed.

Parameters typed at the instances at other parameters: the uniform ones at the uniform parameters' instances, the non-uniform ones at theirs at the other uniform ones.
  Lemma params_typed_at_split : forall Γ D k Mk Ps Ps', decl_closed D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      List.length Ps = im_np D Mk -> List.length Ps' = im_np D Mk ->
      (forall j P P' T, List.nth_error Ps j = Some P -> List.nth_error Ps' j = Some P' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mk) Id Ps) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ P' : T) ->
      (forall j U U' T, List.nth_error (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) j = Some U -> List.nth_error (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps') j = Some U' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U' : T) /\
      (forall j N N' T, List.nth_error (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) j = Some N -> List.nth_error (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps') j = Some N' ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps)) j = Some T ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' : T).
  Proof.
    intros * Hc Hk Hl Hl' HPs.
    assert (HUl : List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) = ind_nu D) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in Hl; lia).
    assert (HUl' : List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps') = ind_nu D) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in Hl'; lia).
    assert (Hti : tele_insts (im_params D Mk) Id Ps
                  = tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)
                    ++ tele_insts (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps)).
    { rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) at 1; unfold im_params; apply tele_insts_app;
        [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact HUl ]. }
    assert (Hl2 : List.length (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) = ind_nu D)
      by (rewrite length_tele_insts by exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc); rewrite HUl; unfold ind_nu; lia).
    split; intros j N N' T HN HN' HT.
    - assert (Hj : j < ind_nu D) by (rewrite <- HUl; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
      apply (HPs j N);
        [ rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps), List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN
        | rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps'), List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HN'
        | rewrite Hti, List.nth_error_app1 by lia; exact HT ].
    - apply (HPs (ind_nu D + j) N).
      + rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps) at 1; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by lia.
        rewrite HUl; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HN.
      + rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (ind_nu D) Ps') at 1; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by lia.
        rewrite HUl'; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HN'.
      + rewrite Hti, List.nth_error_app2 by lia; rewrite Hl2; replace (ind_nu D + j - ind_nu D) with j by lia; exact HT.
  Qed.

The Blocks at Equal Uniform Parameters

An annotation equal to the motive's context's head stays so when the telescope before it changes to an equal one.
  Lemma ext_eq_ann_move : forall Γ Ψ Ψ' κ Z A A', all_assumptions Ψ -> all_assumptions Ψ' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▹{κ} Z ≈ Ψ ▹{κ} A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▹{κ} A ≈ Ψ' ▹{κ} A' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ' ▹{κ} Z ≈ Ψ' ▹{κ} A'.
  Proof.
    intros * Ha Ha' H1 H2.
    destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1) as [S1 HS1 S1' HS1' _ HZ _ HZA HAZ].
    destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2) as [S2 HS2 S2' HS2' H12 _ HA' HAA' HA'A].
Everything read in the right telescope, the heads chained by wf_subtyp_trans.
    pose proof (ctxsub_ext _ _ _ _ _ H12 Ha) as HId.
    pose proof (ctxsub_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HZ) as HZ'.
    pose proof (ctx_ext_refl _ _ _ _ Ha' (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ H12)) as HΨ'.
    eapply wf_ext_eq_ass;
      [ exact HΨ' | exact HZ' | exact HS1 | exact HA' | exact HS2'
      | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HZA) | exact (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HAA') ]
      | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HA'A) | exact (ctxsub_subtyp _ _ _ _ _ _ HId HAZ) ] ].
  Qed.

The blocks of an eliminator typed at the uniform parameters Us are typed at equal ones.
  Lemma blocks_typed_us_conv : forall Γ p D Us Us' Bks r i,
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j U T, nth_error Us j = Some U -> nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : T) ->
      List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      (forall j U T, nth_error Us' j = Some U -> nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us') j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : T) ->
      (forall j U U' T, nth_error Us j = Some U -> nth_error Us' j = Some U' ->
         nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U ≈ U' : T) ->
      blocks_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us Bks r i -> blocks_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' Bks r i.
  Proof.
    intros * Hl HΓ HUl HUs HUl' HUs' HUU HBt.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΓ Hl) as [HD Hc].
    pose proof (wf_sub_uparams _ _ _ HD Hc _ _ HΓ HUl HUs) as Hσ.
    pose proof (wf_sub_uparams _ _ _ HD Hc _ _ HΓ HUl' HUs') as Hσ'.
    assert (Hσσ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id Us ≈ sb_of_list Id Us' : ind_uparams D ++ Γ).
    { eapply wf_sub_eq_of_list_conv; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact (wf_uparams_app _ _ _ HD Hc _ HΓ)
                                     | apply wf_sub_eq_refl, wf_sub_id, HΓ | exact HUl | exact HUl' | exact HUs | exact HUs' | exact HUU ]. }
    assert (HUU' : forall j U' U T, nth_error Us' j = Some U' -> nth_error Us j = Some U ->
               nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us') j = Some T -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U' ≈ U : T).
    { intros j U' U T HU' HU HT.
      exact (wf_sub_eq_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) HUl' HUl (wf_sub_eq_sym _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσσ) _ _ _ _ HU' HU HT). }
    assert (HMc : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us')
      by (intros k Mk Hk; exact (elim_mctx_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσσ)).
    assert (HMv : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us' ++ Γ ⊢ˢ Id : elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ)
      by (intros k Mk Hk; exact (ctxsub_ext _ _ _ _ _ (HMc _ _ Hk) (elim_mctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk))).
    pose proof (blocks_mctx_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HBt) as HM.
    assert (HSi : type_sort (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i)) by (apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor).
    assert (HM' : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us' ++ Γ)
      by (intros j Mj Hj; exact (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ (HMc _ _ Hj))).
    pose proof (rview_struct_suffix _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ HD)) as Hsf.
    pose proof (blocks_motives_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsf HBt) as HA.
    assert (HA' : motives_typed Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' (blocks_motives Bks) r i).
    { intros j Mj Hj Hr; pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HA _ _ Hj Hr) (HMv _ _ Hj)) as H.
      rewrite !exp_sub_id in H; exact H. }
    assert (HBc : forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
               Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ≈ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us')
      by (intros k Mk c gs Hk Hcon;
          exact (elim_bctx_us_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk HΓ HUl HUl' Hσ Hσ' Hσσ HM HM' HA HA' (blocks_typed_kind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HBt) Hcon)).
    destruct HBt as [HlB Hnm HZ HAb HΨ Hn HΨB Hk HB Hmk].
    constructor; try assumption.
    - intros k Mk b Hk' Hb.
      pose proof (HZ _ _ _ Hk' Hb) as HZ0; pose proof (HMc _ _ Hk') as HMk.
      unfold elim_mctx in HZ0, HMk |- *.
      eapply ext_eq_ann_move; [ apply all_assumptions_sub; exact (decl_typed_nparams_ass _ _ _ HD _ _ Hk')
                              | apply all_assumptions_sub; exact (decl_typed_nparams_ass _ _ _ HD _ _ Hk') | exact HZ0 | exact HMk ].
    - intros k Mk b Hk' Hb; pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HAb _ _ _ Hk' Hb) (HMv _ _ Hk')) as H.
      rewrite !exp_sub_id in H; exact H.
    - intros k Mk Hk'; exact (ctx_ext_refl _ _ _ _ (elim_mctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk') (HM' _ _ Hk')).
    - intros k Mk c gs Hk' Hcon.
      exact (ctx_ext_refl _ _ _ _ (elim_bctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk') (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ (HBc _ _ _ _ Hk' Hcon))).
    - intros k Mk b c gs n B Hk' Hb Hcon Hin.
      pose proof (ctxsub_ext _ _ _ _ _ (HBc _ _ _ _ Hk' Hcon) (elim_bctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hc Hk')) as HIdb.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk' Hb Hcon Hin) HIdb) as HB'; rewrite !exp_sub_id in HB'.
      pose proof (wf_branch_type_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hk' (block_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ Hsf HlB Hk' Hb) HΓ HUl' HUs' HUl HUs HUU' HA'
                    Hmk Hcon) as Hbs.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HAb _ _ _ Hk' Hb) (HMv _ _ Hk')) as HA0; rewrite !exp_sub_id in HA0.
      pose proof (sub_eq_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA0 HSi Hbs) as Hty.
      pose proof (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA0 HSi (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hbs)) as Hty'.
      eapply wf_conv_sort; [ exact HB' | exact Hty' | exact HSi | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact Hty ].
  Qed.

End Fixed_GCtx.

The Right-Hand Side of wf_exp_eq_elim_cong

The right eliminator carries the uniform parameters of the right parameters Ps', so it is typed at them: its blocks, typed at the left uniform parameters with the motives varying (wf_elim_cong_rhs_blocks), are typed at the right ones (blocks_typed_us_conv), and so is the scrutinee; its type is then moved to the equation's, at the left parameters and scrutinee. The lemma takes the rule's premises, the right parameters typed at the instances at the left ones.
Lemma wf_elim_cong_rhs : forall Θ Ξ Γ p D Us' m Mm (Bks Bks' : list eblock) bm Ps Ps' M M' r i,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
    List.nth_error Bks m = Some bm ->
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D ->
    List.length Bks' = ind_nblk D ->
    List.length Ps = im_np D Mm ->
    (forall k P T, nth_error Ps k = Some P -> nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ P : T) ->
